name: Chenanisaurus
sum: Late Cretaceous abelisaurid from the phosphates of Morocco, known from a partial dentary and teeth.
holotype: Not given in the sources used.
material: A partial dentary and several teeth from the phosphate mines of Sidi Chennane.
